scope: Static full QP numerator updater complex-product counts, after literal B-zero skips only where the original compact kernel actually branches. Nonliteral B values may also vanish. A-zero products remain in original kernels. Counts exclude ALOHA construction, merging, clearing, scalar integrals and reduction. Filter values are retained startup output. A full point multiplies by active helicities, assuming every generated coefficient batch is evaluated once per active helicity. This does not measure the live point index, rescue fraction or initialization work. The illustrative time assigns all QCD3 mixed-run time to its QP points and scales linearly by static products; it is not a bound or ETA.
